validation_scope: Input checksum and continuity, metric as-of availability, next-open execution, same-path cost replay, and conditional holdout sealing.
evidence: Official archive manifests reported verified SHA-256 inputs.
BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT five-minute series each contained 586944 rows with zero continuity gaps.
Positioning metrics were matched only when timestamped strictly earlier than decision time; median staleness was 300 seconds.
The same raw trade path was replayed under base and stressed cost assumptions.
The 2024 validation period and 2025 conditional holdout remained unopened after the 2022-2023 gate failed.
